name: St. Louis Area Foodbank Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteers help in the Volunteer Center and at food distribution events. In the Center, they help get food ready for people in need.
who_can_apply: The Volunteer Center takes volunteers ages 6 and up. F.A.R.M. distribution events need volunteers who are 16 or older. Food on the Move events need volunteers who are 18 or older. Volunteers under 16 need one adult for every five of them.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Every shift must be scheduled ahead of time.
how_to_apply: Pick a shift on the volunteer sign-up page and register. Do not wear open-heel or open-toe shoes. Minors use the minor waiver form.
notes: The Foodbank requires one adult volunteer for every five volunteers under 16, in groups or not. Plan 3 to 4 months ahead for groups. Court-ordered service is not accepted.
